inspectionBoundary: Specified after observing D4, D5 and D6.1; before Dataset8 predictive scoring. Not blinded preregistration.
nativePopulation: Apply the unchanged D3 functional population, complete closed weak one-hop scope, geometry, feature and nested ridge rules separately to Dataset8. Retain the recorded Dataset7 result as context, without a paired comparison of different populations.
matchedPopulation: Intersect eligible source/receiver pairs in the two native populations. Require identical complete trial ledgers for each shared pair and identical aggregate magnitude and recording identities; any disagreement aborts rather than filtering by outcome. Retain every union pair and missing-side reason. Reapply at least three receivers and two distinct magnitudes within each source; rerank only retained receivers. Require at least five surviving source groups. Refit all six ablations separately on each anatomy using exactly these shared targets.
comparison: Dataset8 minus Dataset7 on matched source groups: baseline, full model and change in full-minus-baseline gain. Equal source weighting, complete vectors and descriptive leave-one-source-out ranges; no IID interval, p-value or claim of improvement from native-population differences.
failure: The complete prepared-scope gate from D5 applies: every prepared scope is required, including context roots with no eligible response targets. Compute all scopes without truncation; any declared geometry work or arithmetic limit makes studies using that anatomy unavailable. Keep target eligibility and the shared-population gate separately visible; no complete-case deletion, fallback model, scope replacement or population pooling.
independence: Two anatomical animals are not two independent functional samples. Both reuse the same processed Randi recordings, exact-label mapping and native measurement limitations. No unseen-animal, causal transmission or population-wide claim.
geometry: Unchanged biological-pair-terminal-geometry-v1: unit initial lengths, half idleness, half step, four maximum iterations, actual terminal state, no cutting.
model: Unchanged D3 grouped weighted ridge and all six D4 ablations; held-out stimulated neuron in both loops, train-only standardization, five fixed penalties, strongest exact-tied penalty, rankSkill primary within each secondary study.
